newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon approves $97 million for rural areas.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon approves $97 million for rural areas.

text.p: Lebanon's parliament approved on Thursday allocation of 150 billion pounds ($97 million) for development in the Bekaa Valley where a former Hizbollah leader has called for civil disobedience against the government.
The cabinet of Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri approved the funds two weeks ago.
Sheikh Sobhi Tufaili launched a "hunger revolt" in the eastern town of Baalbek on July 4 at a rally of several thousand supporters who called for the downfall of the government.
Tufaili urged Bekaa residents to refuse to pay utility bills and taxes to pressure the government to tackle poverty in the area which is suffering economically from a crackdown on illegal drug crops.
